version.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Clarified the purpose of kia_export_refresh_token in SKILL.md: it is now specified as "Only for moving a locally-bootstrapped session into a hosted deployment."
- No functional changes to skill logic.

llm.summary: This is a clearly disclosed Kia account integration for reading vehicle data and sending confirm-gated vehicle commands, with sensitive access that users should configure carefully.

dimensions.detail: Kia username, password, vehicle location, and telematics data are sensitive, but their use is purpose-aligned and described in the skill instructions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup uses an external npm MCP package via npx with Kia credentials supplied in environment variables; this is coherent for the integration but depends on the external package and the user's credential handling.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions disclose write modes, require confirm parameters for commands, warn not to guess vehicle keys, and distinguish dry runs from accepted or confirmed vehicle state changes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses that a local remember-me token is stored and refreshed silently after MFA bootstrap, provides a confirm-gated forget-session tool, and warns that exporting the refresh token reveals a full MFA bypass.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's vehicle status, location, charging, climate, and lock/unlock capabilities match its stated Kia Access / Kia Owners account purpose, but they affect a real vehicle and include sensitive location and control functions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust the npm package and need agent access to your Kia account. Prefer KIA_WRITE_MODE=none for read-only use, use comfort or all only when you want command capability, and treat the local session token or exported refresh token like a password because it can bypass MFA.
